'''Rex''' was the name given to a [[rakghoul]] that [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Wylenn]] was observing during the [[invasion of Taris]]. "Rex" exhibited [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] and began assuming a position of dominance among the pack.
